chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from the one who informed him, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Statement of Allah, Blessed and Exalted: 'There shall come to you the chest in which there is tranquillity from your Lord and residue of the relics of what the children of Musa and the children of Haroun have left, the angels bearing it.' He said: 'The broken pieces of the Tablets in which was the Knowledge and the Wisdom.'

key_terms.رَضْرَاضُ الْأَلْوَاحِ: The broken pieces of the Tablets

ai.seo_question: What are the relics inside the Tabut mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets the 'relics' (baqiyyah) in Surah Al-Baqarah 2:248 as the broken fragments of the Stone Tablets, which serve as a vessel for divine Knowledge (Ilm) and Wisdom (Hikmah). This interpretation underscores the Shia view that the Tabut symbolizes not just physical relics but the transmission of esoteric and exoteric knowledge through the Imams, linking the legacy of Musa and Harun to the Ahl al-Bayt.
